title: Best NZ Beaches for Families — Safest, Most Fun, by Region
meta_desc: Discover the safest and most fun NZ beaches for families, with patrolled beaches and facilities from $10-$20 per day
intro: With over 15,000 kilometres of coastline, New Zealand is a beach lover's paradise, but not all beaches are created equal when it comes to family safety and fun. From the pristine shores of the Bay of Islands to the rugged coastline of the West Coast, we've scouted out the best NZ beaches for families. Here's our top picks, by region, with all the practical info you need to plan a fun and stress-free day out.

sections.heading: North Island Beaches
sections.body: The North Island is home to some of New Zealand's most popular and family-friendly beaches, with many offering patrolled swimming areas and facilities like toilets, showers, and picnic tables. Some top picks include Mission Bay in Auckland, with its tranquil waters and nearby playground, and Mount Maunganui in the Bay of Plenty, with its gentle waves and scenic coastal walk.

sections.heading: South Island Beaches
list: Sumner Beach in Christchurch, with its patrolled swimming area and nearby cafe
Wainui Beach in Kaikoura, with its safe swimming and stunning coastal views
St Clair Beach in Dunedin, with its long stretch of sand and nearby pool

rows: Toilets, showers, picnic tables, coastal walk
Toilets, showers, picnic tables, scenic views

sections.heading: East Coast Beaches
sections.body: The East Coast of the North Island is known for its beautiful and often rugged beaches, with many offering great surfing and swimming spots. Some top picks include Gisborne's Midway Beach, with its consistent waves and nearby surf school, and Napier's Marine Parade, with its scenic views and nearby aquarium. Drive times from major cities include approximately 4.5 hours from Auckland to Gisborne and 3 hours from Wellington to Napier.

sections.heading: West Coast Beaches
list: Raglan Beach, with its world-class surf and stunning sunsets
Muriwai Beach, with its unique black sand and nearby gannet colony
Karioitahi Beach, with its scenic views and nearby picnic areas
